subject: Stakeholder mapping & procurement next steps - Redwood demo follow-up

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.app>

Subject: Stakeholder mapping & procurement next steps - Redwood demo follow-up

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for taking the demo today — appreciate the thoughtful questions. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

1) What we heard on the call
- Primary use case: agent-assisted customer support routing + contextual retrieval for 1st-line agents (avg session length ~6 min).
- Key constraints: sub-200ms p50 latency on inference for short prompts, and strict data residency for logs.
- Decision criteria: latency, total cost per 1k sessions, security/compliance (SOC2 + audit logs), and vendor SLAs.

2) Proposed next steps
- You to confirm the economic buyer and procurement timeline (who signs, PO process).
- We to share SOC2 redacted, SOW template, and an ROI playbook (attached).
- Schedule a procurement + security sync with Carlos and Anya — suggested 30 mins next week.

3) Ask for you (Priya)
- Confirm list of stakeholders (tech lead, procurement, security, legal). If you can share names/roles I’ll map talk tracks for each.

Attachments: 20270620-redwood-demo-summary.pdf (demo highlights), redwood-roi-calculator-2027.xlsx

If that sounds right I’ll loop in our procurement/Security PMs and share a short champion enablement pack for your internal presentation.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.app | (415) 555-0123

Hi Priya / Carlos / Anya —

Thanks — looping in Dev (Solutions Engineering) and Laura (Sales Manager) to support procurement and security questions. Attached: 
- redwood-soc2-2026-redacted.pdf (redacted SOC2 Type II)
- redwood-sow-template.docx (standard SOW + pilot appendix)
- redwood-roi-calculator-2027.xlsx (simple ROI model with sample inputs)

Priya — quick bullets for Carlos (procurement prep):
- Pricing structure: usage-based + committed capacity option for Dedicated (you can cap monthly spend). Pilot typically runs on a 90-day trial with a subsidized committed capacity rate.
- Invoicing: Net 30; we accept PO-based billing and have a standard Master Services Agreement (MSA).
- Concessions for pilots: short-term credits, limited liability threshold increases for pilot only (we document in pilot appendix).

Action items: 
- Dev: can you prep a 20-minute tech deep-dive for Anya (security) focusing on data flows, KMS integration, and logging/retention controls?
- Carlos: can you share your standard procurement checklist / required contract clauses so we can pre-populate?
- Priya: confirm the final attendee list and availability for a 30-min procurement/security sync next week.

We’ll also prepare a short champion enablement pack (talk tracks + ROI bullets) for you to use with internal stakeholders — I’ll send that by Friday.

Best,
Marissa

Marissa —

Got the materials, thanks. Quick procurement checklist/questions so we can move forward without delays: 

1) Please send your standard MSA and SOW (redwood-sow-template.docx is a good start).
2) Data residency: confirm whether logs/metrics can be restricted to our US region and whether you offer VPC/private deployments for pilot (we need this for compliance).
3) SOC2: Anya will review; if there are any open findings please flag them now.
4) Insurance: we require cyber insurance minimum limits — do you have certificate of insurance?
5) Contract review timeline: if we get the SOW this week, internal legal can review and come back with redlines in ~10 business days.

Also include a one-page pricing summary (line items, pilot credits, and what triggers conversion to paid committed capacity).

If we can get those items this week I’ll book a 30-min contract kick-off next Tues (06/29) with our legal and procurement.

Thanks,
Carlos Mendes
Head of Procurement | Finovate Bank

Carlos / Team —

Thanks — attaching the SOW template and a short pricing one-pager. Also included our redacted SOC2 and a champion enablement pack designed for Priya’s internal presentation. Attachments: redwood-sow-template.docx, redwood-pricing-onepager.pdf, redwood-soc2-2026-redacted.pdf, redwood-champion-enablement-pack.zip

Champion enablement quick talk-tracks (for Priya):
- 2-line elevator: "Redwood Inference provides a high-performance, predictable LLM inference platform that reduces per-session latency and cost while keeping data in your region."
- For the Product VP: emphasize pilot ROI — expected 20–30% reduction in average handle time (AHT) and 18% decrease in downstream escalation to specialists, with modeled payback within 3 months for our baseline inputs.
- For Security/Legal: we offer VPC/private deployments, KMS integration, audit logs, and SOC2 Type II; we can scope on-prem options for higher assurance.
- For Procurement: pilot terms include a 90-day trial, pilot credits, Net-30 invoicing, and an MSA with a pilot appendix that limits liability during the trial.

Suggested next steps:
1) Carlos — review attached SOW + pricing one-pager; if okay, confirm meeting 06/29 for contract kickoff.
2) Anya — Dev will send a 20-min tech deep-dive on 06/28 to cover data flows & retention.
3) Priya — use the attached champion pack in your product leadership sync; let us know if you want a short 10-min prep before that meeting.

If helpful, Dev and I are available for a 10-min prep call with your Product VP to run through the ROI bullets and anticipated pilot metrics.

Best,
Marissa Cole
